verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a documented REST API (Records, Workflows, Webhooks), so a downloadable spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for download. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and markdown doc pages are machine-readable documentation, not an API spec, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only standard candidate paths.
